name: snippen-doorman-service-python
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y gh docker.io && sudo chown -R vscode:vscode /home/vscode/.gemini && sudo usermod -aG docker vscode && sudo usermod -aG dialout vscode && python3 -m venv /home/vscode/.venv && /home/vscode/.venv/bin/pip install -e ".[dev]";DOCKER_GID="$(stat -c '%g' /var/run/docker.sock)";groupadd -g $DOCKER_GID docker || true;usermod -aG $DOCKER_GID vscode || usermod -aG docker vscode
